Scientific context

This website presents a personal, hypothetical cosmological concept for discussion and exploration. It should not be interpreted as an established scientific theory or as a verified account of black-hole evaporation, galaxy release, or universe formation. These ideas would require rigorous mathematical development, consistency with established physics, and empirical evidence.
